short_name: ITS fungal community sequencing in agricultural soils
description: Flat metadata schema for individual soil samples sequenced at the ITS region to profile fungal communities under different agricultural management practices, with associated soil physicochemical measurements.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual soil sample record.

plot_id.descr: Identifier for the field plot from which the sample was collected.

site_name.descr: Name of the farm, field site, or experimental station.

country.descr: Country where the sample was collected.

region.descr: Administrative or geographic region of the sampling site.

latitude.descr: Sampling location latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Sampling location longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

sampling_date.descr: Date of soil sample collection in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

sampling_season.descr: Season of collection, such as spring, summer, autumn, or winter.

replicate_id.descr: Replicate identifier within a plot or treatment group.

soil_depth_cm.descr: Depth of soil collection in centimeters; record as a single value or representative depth interval if standardized.

farming_practice.descr: Primary agricultural management practice applied to the plot; examples include conventional tillage, no-till, and organic farming.

tillage_practice.descr: Tillage regime if distinct from the broader farming practice; examples include conventional, reduced, or no-till.

cropping_system.descr: Crop or rotation system present at the time of sampling, if known.

organic_management.descr: Whether the plot is managed under an organic system or certified organic practice.

fertilizer_type.descr: Main fertilizer or amendment type used at the plot; examples include synthetic, manure, compost, or none.

pesticide_use.descr: Whether pesticides were applied to the plot during the relevant management period.

irrigation.descr: Whether the plot was irrigated at or before sampling.

soil_moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content as a percentage of fresh weight or equivalent standardized basis.

soil_organic_matter_percent.descr: Soil organic matter content as a percentage.

soil_organic_carbon_percent.descr: Soil organic carbon content as a percentage, if measured.

soil_total_n_percent.descr: Total soil nitrogen content as a percentage, if measured.

soil_ph.descr: Soil pH measured in an appropriate soil-water or soil-solution suspension.

available_phosphorus_mgkg.descr: Plant-available phosphorus concentration in mg/kg soil.

exchangeable_potassium_mgkg.descr: Exchangeable potassium concentration in mg/kg soil.

mineral_nitrate_mgkg.descr: Nitrate concentration in mg/kg soil, if measured.

mineral_ammonium_mgkg.descr: Ammonium concentration in mg/kg soil, if measured.

electrical_conductivity_dsm.descr: Soil electrical conductivity in dS/m, if measured.

bulk_density_gcm3.descr: Soil bulk density in g/cm^3, if measured.

soil_texture_class.descr: Textural class of the soil, such as sandy loam, loam, clay loam, or clay.

sample_storage_condition.descr: Storage condition after collection; examples include on ice, -20 C, or -80 C.

dna_extraction_kit.descr: Name of the DNA extraction kit or protocol used.

dna_extraction_date.descr: Date of DNA extraction, if available.

its_target_region.descr: ITS region targeted by amplification; examples include ITS1 or ITS2.

forward_primer.descr: Forward primer sequence or primer name used for ITS amplification.

reverse_primer.descr: Reverse primer sequence or primer name used for ITS amplification.

pcr_cycles.descr: Number of PCR amplification cycles used.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used; examples include Illumina MiSeq or NovaSeq.

sequencing_strategy.descr: Sequencing strategy used; examples include paired-end 2x300 bp or single-end.

library_preparation_protocol.descr: Library preparation protocol or kit used for sequencing.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for the primary reads.

raw_read_count.descr: Number of raw sequence reads generated for the sample.

post_qc_read_count.descr: Number of reads retained after quality control and filtering.

chimera_filtered.descr: Whether chimeric reads were removed during processing.

asv_or_otu_method.descr: Method used for feature inference, such as ASV, OTU clustering, or DADA2.

bioinformatic_pipeline.descr: Software pipeline used for sequence processing and taxonomic assignment.

database_used.descr: Reference database used for ITS taxonomic assignment, such as UNITE.

fungal_diversity_metric.descr: Primary diversity metric calculated for the sample, if stored in the metadata table; examples include Shannon or observed richness.

fungal_relative_abundance_total.descr: Total relative abundance of fungal reads after processing, typically 1.0 or 100 if normalized; use only if this field is explicitly tracked.

soil_health_indicator.descr: Optional categorical or summary indicator linking the sample to soil health assessment, if defined by the study.

notes.descr: Free-text notes about anomalies, missing values, or special handling relevant to this sample.
